sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Shri Kaushalendra Singh, Advocate holding brief of
Shri Devesh Kumar Verma, learned counsel for the respondent no. 3 and learned A.G.A. for the
State-respondents.

2.  Although, the prayer made in this writ petition is to quash the First Information Report dated 17.09.2025 of Case Crime No. 0560 of 2025 under Sections 120B, 420, 406 of I.P.C., Police Station-Dibyapur, District-Auraiya, but at the time when the matter is taken up learned counsel for the petitioners confines his relief to grant of protection under section 35 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
3.

We have perused the First Information Report, which prima facie discloses commissioning of cognizable offence and, therefore, the prayer made to quash F.I.R. otherwise cannot be entertained in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani, (2017) 2 SCC 779 and Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others, (2021) SCC Online SC 315.
4.

entities.text: State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani, (2017) 2 SCC 779
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others, (2021) SCC Online SC 315
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We are of the view that no interference is warranted.

5. However, considering the fact that all offences mentioned in the present case are punishable with a term up to 7 years, the authorities are directed to ensure the procedure of arrest as per the guidelines of the Supreme Court enshrined in the case of Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273.
6.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is expected of the police not to harass the petitioners till the conclusion of the investigation in any manner whatsoever.
7. The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
